title: tapflow flow
description: Deterministic UI test flow replayed by @tapflowio/flow-runner (tapflow flow run). Frames and coordinates are normalized 0-1.

name.description: Flow name shown in reports. Defaults to the file name.

appId.description: Bundle id / application id of the app under test. Required for the bare clearState step. When a run names a build, a flow whose appId differs from the build's is skipped.

tags.description: Labels for choosing flows with --include-tags / --exclude-tags. No commas.

oneOf.description: Bare selector: matched as exact identifier, then exact label, then partial label.

label.description: Label text (exact match first, then substring).

role.description: Narrow the match by element kind (button, text, cell, input, …).

index.description: 0-based: pick the Nth remaining match when role/label still resolve to several.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the element (default 10, max 2147483.647). Minimum 0.0005: smaller values round to 0ms and the parser rejects them.

oneOf.description: Reset the app data of the flow-level appId.
Launch the build under test (tapflow flow run --build).

clearState.description: Reset the app data of this bundle id.

launchApp.description: Launch the build under test with launch arguments, and on iOS environment variables. A running app is restarted so it reads them.

arguments.description: iOS: passed as -key value (read with UserDefaults). Android: intent extras typed by value (read with getIntent().getExtras()). Quote a number to pass it as a string.

env.description: iOS only: environment variables for the app's process. Refused on Android.

pressKey.description: KeyboardEvent.code name: Enter, Backspace, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, …

pressButton.description: Press a hardware button: home on both platforms; lock, power, volume_up, volume_down where the device has them; back, recent_apps on Android. A flow pressing a button the device lacks fails before it runs.

longPressOn.description: Press and hold the element a selector names. A bare selector holds for 1000ms; to change the time, put the selector under "on".

setOrientation.description: Turn the device and wait until it reports the new orientation. Points in later steps are placed in the app as it is drawn.

setPosture.description: Fold or unfold a foldable and wait until it reports the posture. A device that does not fold fails the step as the environment's.

pinch.description: Two fingers about the center of an element or a point: scale above 1 spreads them (zoom in), below 1 closes them.
